text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Is this... from the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Power seems to be welling up from 
deep inside me. ――This is love, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Goddesses Three. Drawing 
strength from your love, I'll do my very 
best!
